title: A CYCLE WALK FOR SAMPLING MEASURES ON SPANNING FORESTS FOR REDISTRICTING
reasoning: The paper is a technical mathematical study focused on developing and validating a new Markov Chain algorithm (the Cycle Walk) for sampling graph partitions.
